annotations.title: Get the physical sensations for a body region

description: Returns the physical sensations people report in one body region of the Surfacing body map, such as "Heart & Chest", "Stomach", or "Face & Expression". Relevant when someone describes a feeling through their body, for example "my chest is tight" or "my jaw is clenched".

region.description: Body region name, for example "Breathing" or "Legs & Feet".

name: get_body_sensations
title: Get the physical sensations for a body region
